name: ST NUCLEO-H745ZI-Q
record_note: The MB1363 H745 board uses 8 MHz ST-LINK MCO as default HSE; UM2408 also documents a 25 MHz X2 HSE crystal path and a default 32.768 kHz X3 LSE crystal. HSE can be changed by solder-bridge configuration and ST-LINK firmware. Board revision, dual-core startup, pin reservations, and build/flash profiles remain open; ST lists this SKU out of production.
